trialSummary.fullTitle: Lowering events in non-proliferative retinopathy in Scotland
trialSummary.background: Diabetic retinopathy is a common complication of diabetes mellitus which can result in loss of vision. For this reason, individuals with diabetes are routinely invited for retinal screening. In Scotland, this screening is carried out by the national Diabetic Eye Screening (DES) programme. The programme takes images of the eyes which are then assessed according to the DES programme grading scheme. In the event of diabetes-related changes to the eyes, the individual may be invited to begin treatment.
